title: PCV, EVAP and EGR as hidden mixture faults
whatItIs: PCV, EVAP and EGR are not just emissions hardware. Leaks or stuck valves can change mixture, idle stability, MAP and combustion quality while pointing misleadingly at oxygen sensors.
normalValues: At warm idle, commanded purge/EGR should not create uncontrolled mixture or dilution. Fuel trims should return when the flow path is isolated or commanded closed.
deviations: Purge stuck open can look lean or rich depending on vapor content
PCV diaphragm tears create idle-biased air leaks
EGR stuck open dilutes idle charge and can cause rough idle or rich/lean confusion
EVAP symptoms often appear after refueling or heat soak
influence: Many real P0171/P0172 cases are fixed in these systems, not by replacing A/F or O2 sensors.
checks: Compare trims at idle and 2500 RPM
Command or isolate purge/EGR where safe
Smoke test PCV and intake paths
Verify repair by watching trim response return toward zero
